question: Find the equation of the plane passing through the points $(1,0,0)$, $(0,2,0)$ and $(0,0,3)$ in Cartesian form.
explanation:
Using determinant form of plane through three points.

$\left|\begin{array}{ccc}x-1 & y & z \\-1 & 2 & 0 \\-1 & 0 & 3\end{array}\right|=0$.

Expanding along first row gives:

$(x−1)(6) − y(−3) + z(2)=0$.

$6(x−1)+3y+2z=0$.

Thus the required plane is $6x+3y+2z=6$.
